body:
I think it's time to start focusing on getting the insane fucks in so-called
power out of office right now.

Living in the past is so easy.

And he did blow those people up, so he should be in prison, period.

So, if you have any more to add, how about you pet your kitty instead and
start learning how to allow her to shred your arms while you learn how a
cat's mind works, which will allow the two of you to do a bonding thing
which is critical with cats, so she also can get that 'they took me away
from my cat mommy too soon' stuff out of her system?



"Poop Dogg" <nospam@nospam.com> wrote in message
news:gRydndXhANv7YH6jXTWcpA@bravo.net...
I was unpacking a box of books and dug up "Mad Genius," a book
about Ted Kaczynski.  He is so cool.  They try to portray him
as schizophrenic in an attempt to discredit the ideas he
outlines in his essay.  But when you read it you realize that
everything he says is true.

I think Ted should be given a full presidential pardon so that
he may lead the revolution against the technological/industrial
system of society.

"The factories should be destroyed, technical books burned, etc."
-- The Unabomber Manifesto
